name: Ferienwohnung Notburga
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on the heights of Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Notburga provides cosy living space with an inviting balcony overlooking the surrounding peaks.

Lake Thiersee and hiking trails up Mount Pendling are just moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Notburga in Thiersee offers comfortable holiday accommodations and panoramic vistas in Kufsteinerland.
